body: Extended 2026-11-23: `cargo update -p cookie --precise 0.18.3` re-resolved the same two `syn` edges (`bindgen`, `cssparser-macros` 3.0.6 → 2.0.119), so on this lock a targeted `cargo update -p` is not a lock-only move. A patch bump of one crate is made by editing its `version` and `checksum` lines alone, then read by `git diff --numstat -- Cargo.lock`, a `--locked` build and the audit leg.

`--pattern` is a list option: `--pattern A B C` runs the three named patterns, and so does `--pattern A --pattern B --pattern C` — a repeated `--pattern` adds to its list (cascade v1.37) [corrected 2026-11-23: a P1 re-fire with eight repeated `--pattern` flags printed `total (8 patterns)`; the flag kept only the last one in an older stamp]. A re-fire that should run only the patterns whose control never fired names each of them. Read the count line of each pattern the listing prints before trusting a re-fire: the number of patterns run is in its `total (N patterns)` line.

- 2026-11-23: While an editor's cargo (rust-analyzer's `cargo check --workspace`) runs on the shared `target/`, cargo can read a crate `Fresh` against sources just edited, so a test reads the pre-edit code — a re-run or a `touch` does not clear it and `cargo clean -p {crate}` does; a red that holds after an edit is first re-read after that clean, never taken as the edit's verdict.

The session fixed where a custom widget (canvas) paints: its paint size is now its content box times scale, and its scene is placed at the content origin inside the element's own transform, unclipped (upstream issue 1578).
A custom widget now hears pointer events in its content-box frame, offset by its left and top border and padding; a sub-document's pointer events are unchanged, still from its border-box origin.
The widget trait gains one defaulted method that hands the widget the document's own shared font context before each paint, and the document gains a public reader of that font context, so canvas text is shaped from the bundled fonts.
Three new integration checks witness the paint placement, the widget pointer frame and the canvas text, in both layout modes; the stand check files move 66 to 69, and the stand repeat leg takes them by prefix with its named-target count unchanged.
The test crate takes parley as a dev-dependency (one lock line, no package added), and cookie moves 0.18.2 to 0.18.3 lock-only for RUSTSEC-2026-0594; no log site, span, field, carrier, verb or accessibility surface is added.

Range input rows that read a content box (the main-button pointerdown and click value rows, the range pointerdown decision): check they stay a native control's own rule and are not a custom widget's; the sweep found them sharing the content-box token only.
Driver screenshot rows (an element shot, a row shot) and the screenshot-changes-nothing decision: a canvas widget's pixels inside an element shot now sit at its content box, not its border box.

Contrast unread past non-colour paint and stand contrast measured from computed styles: a canvas widget's painted content and text are non-colour paint the contrast reader does not reach; check no row claims it measures canvas pixels.

Hidpi or zoom change reshapes text: canvas text is now shaped from the document's shared font context, which app code can hold and mutate; check whether the reshaping rule claims any reach over widget-drawn text.

Stand checks repeated three rounds and the accessibility test leg: three new stand check files join the repeat leg by prefix, with no named-target count changed; touch only where a row's cell holds the file count or the target count.

body_fields.fact: A custom widget's paint size is its content box times the scale (the border box less border and padding, floored at 0). Its scene is appended at the content origin inside the element's transform and stays unclipped. This follows upstream issue 1578, and the guard is stand_canvas_placement.

body: The typography contract on the dioxus-native configuration's FontContext: the one font context the document is built with now also reaches custom widgets, handed to each before paint, so that contract gains a second consumer.

The typography decision on the bundled font context on WASM and the WASM font-context configuration contract: widget text now shapes from the same document context, so whatever fonts the document resolves (bundled or system) are the widget's fonts too.

The typography decisions that tests and the test engine are built with system fonts: the new canvas text check runs on that build and compares the document route byte-equal to the bundled route, in both layout modes and under font-embolden.
The typography decision that a screenshot never paints with text skipped: the canvas text check reads text a widget drew into a screenshot region as non-blank, a new witness of text in a shot.

The decisions that unavailable families fall back to the default font and that no generic family lays out as sans-serif: canvas text now resolves families through the same document context, so those fallbacks now govern widget text as well (indirect, through the shared context).

The depth-strategy decision that a stacking-context root groups paint and hit-testing: a widget's scene is now appended inside the element's transform rather than outside it, so a transformed element's widget paints inside that transform, unclipped.

The depth-strategy decisions that hit-testing stops at a paint clip: the widget's scene stays unclipped while its pointer frame moved to the content box; hit-testing itself is unchanged, but the coordinates a widget hears are now content-box relative.

The screenshot verb contracts on the desktop-native surface: a shot of a page with a padded custom widget now shows the widget's paint inside its content box, padding and border left to the element's own background.
The spacing area: padding and border around a custom widget now lie outside its painted surface and outside its pointer frame, a box-model rule no spacing row states yet.

body_fields.because: The chunk adds the font-context handoff to custom widgets, a contract the typography section does not yet state.

body_fields.because: The chunk moves a custom widget's paint size, scene origin and pointer frame to its content box, a spacing decision no row of the section states.
